ov: بوليس هو فيلم من نوع دراما وجريمة أُصدر في 2011. الفيلم من إنتاج Les Productions du Trésor ‏، ومن توزيع لوكي ريد للتوزيع ‏، وهو من إخراج مايوين، أما السيناريو فكان من كتابة مايوين وإيمانويل بيركو.
plotEn:
The members of a Child Protection Unit police squad try to safeguard their mental health and home lives in the face of their stressful and disruptive work: tracking paedophiles, arresting parents suspected of mistreating their children, following pickpockets, runaways or those sexually exploited and helping in the protection of homeless little boys and girls and victims of rape.
During brief periods of relaxation, the squad gossip, quarrel, drink, dance; relationships are put under strain, break and are remade or newly made. Their boss is an ambitious and politically astute policeman, not wholly sympathetic to the demands of their consciences, and ready to tighten the leash if the suspect whom they are questioning has powerful friends. At the heart of the story is a hard-edged, bitter yet tender policeman (Joeystarr), and a photographer (played by director Maïwenn), whose assignment is to follow the squad in their work.
